title: OpenLineage Lineage Emission Drop
dataSources: Collibra audit (`collibra:audit`), Alation/Atlan audit, DataHub events, OpenLineage runs (`openlineage:event`), Unity Catalog audit (`unity_catalog:audit`), Purview scans (`purview:scan`).
app: Catalog/governance audit exports (Collibra, Alation, Atlan, DataHub, Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview) via REST APIs and OpenLineage events to HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=openlineage:event eventType="COMPLETE"
| timechart span=1d dc(job.name) as jobs_emitting
| eventstats avg(jobs_emitting) as avg_jobs
| where jobs_emitting<avg_jobs*0.8
description: Counts distinct jobs emitting OpenLineage COMPLETE events per day and flags drops, which mean lineage coverage is silently eroding as jobs stop reporting.
value: Lineage is only useful if it is complete; an emission drop means impact analysis and root-cause tracing are quietly going blind.
implementation: Ingest OpenLineage events from your emitters; schedule daily and alert when emitting-job count falls below 80% of baseline.
visualization: Timechart of emitting jobs, drop markers.
grandmaExplanation: We make sure the map of how data flows keeps getting updated so we can always trace where a number came from.
